review_comments.body:
if somebody sets `--socket=` (which also means paths.DefaultTailscaledSocket), then this code prints an empty string here instead of the implicit value.

How about you change this to `cmp.Or(localClient.Socket, paths.DefaultTailscaledSocket())` ?

comments.body:

Could you amend the commit, changing the style?

Thanks, done: the output now uses `cmp.Or(localClient.Socket, paths.DefaultTailscaledSocket())`, so `--socket=` prints the implicit default instead of an empty string. Added an empty-`--socket` case to `TestLocalCredsSocket`.
